title: Transpose-odd operator chirality in co-moving multiplicative processes: exact tail-level structure and a detectability obstruction
abstract: arXiv:2609.35923v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We ask whether transposition changes the stationary heavy tail of the co-moving recursion $\mathbf x_{t+1}=Q_tBQ_t^\top\mathbf x_t+Q_t\boldsymbol\eta_t$ in $d=3$. The model has independent Haar rotations, Gaussian body-frame noise with covariance $\Sigma$, and an explicit positive metric $\mathsf g$. The tail index $\alpha_\star$ depends only on singular values, so $\alpha_\star(B)=\alpha_\star(B^\top)$.   The structure theorem and polar-twist mechanism are unconditional. In the $\mathsf g=I$ chart, write $B=S+\widehat{\boldsymbol\omega}$: $\Delta_6(B)=-16\det[\boldsymbol\omega,S\boldsymbol\omega,S^2\boldsymbol\omega]$. Then $B\not\sim_{O(3)}B^\top$, $\Delta_6(B)\ne0$, $\operatorname{rank}[\boldsymbol\omega,S\boldsymbol\omega,S^2\boldsymbol\omega]=3$, and controllability of $(S,\boldsymbol\omega)$ are equivalent; intrinsic operator chirality is a Kalman rank condition.   Unlike the exponent, the tail level need not be transpose-invaria

translated_title: 共动乘性过程中的转置奇算符手性：精确尾级结构及可探测性障碍
translated_abstract: 我们探讨在 $d=3$ 时，转置是否会改变共动递推 $\mathbf x_{t+1}=Q_tBQ_t^\top\mathbf x_t+Q_t\boldsymbol\eta_t$ 的平稳重尾。该模型包含独立的 Haar 随机旋转、协方差为 $\Sigma$ 的体坐标系高斯噪声，以及一个显式的正度量 $\mathsf g$。尾指数 $\alpha_\star$ 仅依赖于奇异值，因此 $\alpha_\star(B)=\alpha_\star(B^\top)$。结构定理与极扭机制是无条件的。在 $\mathsf g=I$ 的坐标图中，写 $B=S+\widehat{\boldsymbol\omega}$：$\Delta_6(B)=-16\det[\boldsymbol\omega,S\boldsymbol\omega,S^2\boldsymbol\omega]$。于是 $B\not\sim_{O(3)}B^\top$、$\Delta_6(B)\ne0$、$\operatorname{rank}[\boldsymbol\omega,S\boldsymbol\omega,S^2\boldsymbol\omega]=3$ 以及 $(S,\boldsymbol\omega)$ 的可控性彼此等价；内在算符手性是一个 Kalman 秩条件。与尾指数不同，尾级未必是转置不变的……
tldr: 该论文证明在 $d=3$ 共动乘性随机递推中，重尾指数对矩阵转置不变（仅由奇异值决定），而尾级却不然——内在算符手性被刻画为一个等价于 $(S,\boldsymbol\omega)$ 可控性的 Kalman 秩条件，由此导出精确的尾级结构及尾级转置不变性失效所造成的可探测性障碍。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that in $d=3$ co-moving multiplicative recursions the heavy-tail exponent is transpose-invariant (depending only on singular values) whereas the tail level is not, characterizing intrinsic operator chirality via a Kalman rank condition equivalent to controllability of $(S,\boldsymbol\omega)$, and deriving the exact tail-level structure together with a detectability obstruction.
